TotalChargesCleaner.source:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TotalChargesCleaner(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TotalChargesCleaner",
        kind=OperatorKind.IMPUTER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将total_charges字段中的空白字符处理为0.0并转为数值类型",
        conditions=["数据包含字符串类型的数值列total_charges"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"col": "total_charges"},
        parent="TotalChargesCleaner@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="total_charges"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col in X.columns:
            # 根据 Lesson:69d51358：先去除空白字符，再转为数值，最后填充缺失值
            X[self.col] = pd.to_numeric(
                X[self.col].astype(str).str.strip(), 
                errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(0.0)
            
            # 处理可能产生的无穷值
            X[self.col] = X[self.col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0)
        return X

IdColumnDropper.source:
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class IdColumnDropper(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="IdColumnDropper",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="删除客户ID等无预测价值的特征，防止后续建模出现维度爆炸。",
        conditions=["数据包含客户ID等唯一标识列"],
        dependencies=[],
        params={"id_cols": ("customer_id",)},
        parent="IdColumnDropper@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, id_cols=("customer_id",)):
        self.id_cols = id_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        """记录应当删除的列，不执行计算。"""
        self.cols_to_drop_ = [c for c in self.id_cols if c in X.columns]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        """安全删除指定列，确保不修改原数据。"""
        if not isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame):
            return X
        
        X_copy = X.copy()
        existing_cols_to_drop = [c for c in self.cols_to_drop_ if c in X_copy.columns]
        if existing_cols_to_drop:
            X_copy = X_copy.drop(columns=existing_cols_to_drop)
            
        return X_copy

TenureBucketizer.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TenureBucketizer(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TenureBucketizer",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="对tenure进行分箱以辅助模型识别流失周期",
        conditions=["存在tenure数值列"],
        dependencies=["numpy", "pandas", "sklearn"],
        params={"col": "tenure"},
        parent="TenureBucketizer@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="tenure"):
        self.col = col
        self.bins_ = [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, np.inf]
        self.labels_ = ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        # 记录转换状态，以便后续验证
        self.fitted_ = True
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col not in X.columns:
            return X
            
        # 确保输入列为数值型，处理脏数据
        col_data = pd.to_numeric(X[self.col], errors='coerce')
        
        # 分箱处理，包含缺失值处理（缺失值会被切分为 NaN，astype(str)转为'nan'）
        # 如果需要保持原列类型，可以保留缺失值而不填充
        bucketed = pd.cut(col_data, bins=self.bins_, labels=self.labels_)
        
        # 将分箱结果合并，将未匹配的（含原缺失值）统一映射为 'unknown' 或保持字符串化
        X[f"{self.col}_bucket"] = bucketed.astype(str).replace('nan', 'unknown')
        
        return X

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: LightGBM 调参及不平衡处理
lessons.trigger: 数据量在 5k 到 10w 之间，或者样本不平衡时
lessons.fix: 设置 num_leaves 15~63, learning_rate 0.03~0.1, n_estimators 200~600；不平衡时设置 class_weight='balanced'；树模型无需标准化。
